components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Self-contained translation of the implemented shared Button primary variant.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:8px; white-space:nowrap; font-family:var(--font-application,"Noto Sans Arabic"),sans-serif; font-size:14px; line-height:20px; font-weight:600; transition:color 180ms,background-color 180ms,box-shadow 180ms; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--primary,#19454b); outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring,#0aa9b2) 45%,transparent); } .ds-btn:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:.45; } .ds-btn[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--accent-soft,#E5F5F2); } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-btn { transition-duration:.01ms; } } .ds-primary { background:var(--primary,#19454b);color:var(--primary-foreground,#ffffff);box-shadow:0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--primary-hover,#123a3f); }

components.description: Shared field with mobile/desktop font sizes and actual focus/disabled states.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" dir="rtl" aria-label="اسم المشروع" placeholder="اسم المشروع">

narrative.overview:
The user approved implementation of the Figma plan. This document records the current feature-branch application, whose code is the canonical implementation for this change. It has not been merged or deployed. Figma remains the approved visual reference, not a production runtime or component implementation.

The Arabic-first workspace uses warm paper, white panels, and precise teal controls. Real carousel artwork leads the home and gallery; six visual families supply expressive compositions while editing controls remain calm. Native editable text, code, shapes, and diagrams carry the artwork.
keyCharacteristics: Arabic-first controls with isolated LTR code and numeric measurements.
Restrained application chrome and distinct artwork palettes.
Real project previews and progressively exposed mobile tools.

rules.name: The Separate Palettes Rule
rules.body: Keep application controls on the chrome palette; use the selected visual family for exported artwork.

rules.name: The Mixed Direction Rule
rules.body: Keep Arabic text RTL and code LTR; preserve Arabic shaping and explicit font weights.

rules.name: The Content Preservation Rule
rules.body: Preview a family change and preserve additional edited text, code, images, groups, and shapes when applying it.

dos: Do use bundled Noto Sans Arabic, IBM Plex Mono, and DM Sans for the default experience.
Do retain 44px control targets, 48px main actions, visible focus, and reduced-motion support.
Do scale native artwork to the actual preset or custom geometry.
Do keep content outlines independent from visual families and preserve edited content during a family change.
donts: Don't turn output grouping or a publishing-service limit into a project slide cap.
Don't replace actual saved-project or export previews with illustrative content.
Don't reuse the old Figma specimen dimensions as production component defaults.
